title: Maganin ƙwayoyin cuta, sanitiser, rubutu da sayarwa

say: Maganin Kashe Ƙwayoyin Cuta, Sanitiser, Rubutun Kaya da Bunƙasa Kasuwanci. Wannan shi ne babi na 5, babi na ƙarshe na kwas ɗin.
Waɗannan kaya suna kare lafiya, don haka dokokinsu sun fi tsauri. Bari mu yi su daidai.

shots.label: A fara wankewa, sannan a kurkura
say: Ki kalli yadda ake fesa wannan teburi a goge shi da sabulu tukuna. Datti da maiko suna kare ƙwayoyin cuta kuma suna cinye maganin.
Don haka tsarin kullum shi ne: a fara wankewa, a kurkura, sannan a kashe ƙwayoyin cuta.

shots.label: Safar hannu da kariyar ido
say: Kafin ki tsarma bilicin, ki saka safar hannu da kariyar ido. Ki yi amfani da ruwan sanyi a wurin da iska ke shiga.

shots.label: Bilicin (sodium hypochlorite)

card.title: Tsarmawar bilicin na Grace
rows: C1 x V1 = C2 x V2
card.note: WHO: 0.1% wurare gaba ɗaya, 0.5% zubewar jini

say: Waɗannan kofuna suna farawa daga bilicin mai ƙarfi zuwa tsarma mai rauni. Kina lissafawa da C1 sau V1 daidai da C2 sau V2.
Grace a Ilorin tana buƙatar 0.1% don ƙasa da 0.5% don kayan goge zubewa. Duka biyun sun ɗauki kusan mililita 286 na bilicinta na 3.5%, an dai cika su zuwa yawa daban-daban.
Tana rubuta ƙarfi, kwanan wata da lokaci a kowane bokiti, kuma ba ta taɓa ƙara wa tsohon bokiti ba.

shots.label: Bilicin da maganin asid
shots.banner: Kada ki haɗa bilicin da asid ko ammonia
say: Ki raba waɗannan biyun. Kada ki taɓa haɗa bilicin da asid, ammonia ko wasu magungunan wanki.
Ki ajiye bilicin da aka tsarma a robobi masu rubutu, nesa da rana kuma nesa da yara. Ki kurkura wuraren ƙarfe bayan lokacin aikinsa.

shots.label: Benzalkonium chloride (BKC)

card.title: Lissafin gwajin BKC na Musa
card.note: Kullum ki bi rubutun ainihin kayan

say: Ki ga yadda wurin yake zama a jike yayin da agogo ke tafiya. Wannan shi ne lokacin aiki, kuma goge shi ya bushe da wuri kuskure ne da aka saba yi.
Quat kamar BKC, ragowar sabulu yana hana su aiki, don haka ki kurkura tukuna. Musa ya auna giram 40 na mai kauri 50% cikin kusan lita 9, sannan ya cika zuwa 10.

shots.label: Kayan da aka yi wa rajista kawai
say: Kalmomi kamar maganin kashe ƙwayoyin cuta ko yana kashe 99.9% na ƙwayoyin cuta iƙirarin lafiya ne. A Najeriya suna buƙatar rajistar NAFDAC, hukumar kula da abinci da magunguna, da gwajin tasiri.
Har zuwa lokacin, ki sayar da gaskiya a matsayin sabulun tsabtace wuri, ki koya wa masu saye su yi amfani da magungunan da aka yi wa rajista daidai.

shots.label: Sanitiser na WHO, Tsari na 1
say: Yanzu maganin goge hannu, wato sanitiser. Waɗannan kwalaben awo suna ɗauke da alcohol, hydrogen peroxide da glycerol, tsarin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya, WHO.
Peroxide yana kashe ƙwayoyin spores, glycerol kuma yana kare fata. Idan kika canza tsarin, ba tsarin WHO ba ne kuma.

shots.label: Babu wuta, babu janareta
shots.banner: Kada ki taɓa amfani da methanol
say: Methanol guba ne ta fata da kuma idan an haɗiye shi. Ki sayi ethanol ko isopropyl alcohol mai takardar shaidar gwaji.
Tururin alcohol yana kama wuta cikin sauƙi. Ki haɗa kusa da taga a buɗe, babu wuta, babu gas na girki, babu shan taba, babu janareta a kusa.

shots.label: Alcoholmeter ya nuna: 90%

card.title: Gwajin Hadiza na lita 2
card.note: Ba tare da gyara ba: kusan 75% kawai

say: Hadiza a Sakkwato ta duba ethanol ɗinta da alcoholmeter, wato mitar auna alcohol. Ya nuna 90%, ba 96% ba.
Don haka ta auna mililita 1,778 maimakon mililita 1,667, kuma sanitiser ɗin da ta gama ya kai 80%.

shots.label: Cika, rufe, keɓewa
say: Ki cika, ki rufe, ki rubuta a kowace kwalba kashin alcohol, lambar haɗi, kwanan wata da Yana kama wuta: a nisanta daga wuta.
Sannan ki riƙe su na awa 72 kafin a yi amfani da su. Wannan keɓewa wani ɓangare ne na tsarin.

shots.label: Suna ɗaya, rubutu a fili

card.title: Lambar haɗin Ada
rows: kaya, nauyi, pH, wanda ya yi

say: Kowane rubutu yana buƙatar suna, yawan abin da ke ciki, sinadarai mafi yawa a farko, yadda ake amfani, gargaɗi, wanda ya yi, lambar NAFDAC da bayanin haɗi.
Ada a Legas ta gano bayanan wata kwalba mai tsululu cikin mintuna, saboda lamba irin wannan.
A teburinta, Comfort a Asaba ta haɗa kashi uku na kuɗin da ta kashe ta raba da kwalabe 40.
Kuɗin kwalabe da naɗi ya kusa kai na ruwan sabulun. Don haka tana neman famfon kwalba mai araha kafin ta ƙara farashinta.
Ki girma mataki-mataki, kilogiram 20, sannan kilogiram 50, sannan kilogiram 100, kina gwaji a kowane mataki.

shots.label: Manyan masu saye na cibiyoyi

card.title: Farashin Ngozi ga otal mai ɗaki 40

say: Otal, makarantu da ofisoshi suna sake oda kowane wata. Ngozi ta yi gwaji na sati biyu, sannan ta ba da farashi daga ainihin amfani.
Idan bashin kwana 30 ne, dole ta biya kayan kusan naira 30,800 kowane wata. Ki rubuta sharuɗɗa a takarda, kuma kada ki taɓa kai kayan da ba a yi wa rajista ba ga asibitoci.
Yanzu ki bi darussan da ke ƙasa. Ki yi jadawalin tsarmawarki, haɗin sanitiser naki a takarda, rubutunki na kaya da takardar lissafin kuɗi, sannan ki shirya bayani ɗaya ga wata cibiya.
Madalla da kika kammala kwas ɗin.
